name: Default
shortDescription: XWiki enterprise wiki with structured pages, fine-grained rights, office import and export, and a bundled PostgreSQL database.

alerts.message: Open the site right after the first start, which takes a few minutes. The Distribution Wizard registers the first account as the wiki administrator, so whoever reaches it first owns the wiki. It then downloads the XWiki Standard flavor from the XWiki extension repository, which needs outbound internet access.
